cards.card_text: Zechariah looks out into the night and sees a man riding a red horse among the myrtle trees in the hollow, with red, sorrel and white horses behind him.
cards.verse_text: He was standing among the myrtle trees in the hollow, and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses.
cards.snippet: …among the myrtle trees in the hollow, and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses.
